description: Find other Threads that observed this workspace-relative file changing during a tool operation. Observations do not prove authorship: users or concurrent processes may have changed it. Use when another task's changes need clarification; no query is required before ordinary edits.

propertyDescriptions.path: Workspace-relative file path using the same folder-key notation as read_file. Absolute paths and parent traversal are forbidden. Deleted files can be queried.

guidance: Available in Plan and Code. Returned Thread IDs can be contacted with send_thread_message. Do not infer ownership or permission from an observation.
